local_review.finding_body: `build.gradle` applied four class-initialization arguments to `graalvmNative.binaries.all`, contrary to the narrowest-flag requirement in `FS-test-contract.2.7`. Removing the flags reproduced image-heap failures for `NOPLoggerFactory`, `SubstituteLoggerFactory`, `Base64Variant`, and `Base64Variant$PaddingReadBehaviour`, establishing that the transitive Azure/Jackson/SLF4J paths require them; only their binary scope needed correction.
local_review.finding_title: Native Image build flags were scoped too broadly
local_review.fix_note: Scoped the four demonstrated class-initialization arguments from every native binary to the `test` binary, then ran the exact Forge review finalization command to a stable successful pass.
local_review.review_comment: Checked the single-coordinate diff, test contract, metadata format and scope, index and rendered statistics. The tests exercise the public client API from a separate, version-independent test package with bounded execution and no Native Image skip or tolerated failure. The reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case. After the repair, Forge finalization passed all three native-test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
